correctness.rationale: Two deletion positions agree iff all intervening coordinates satisfy period-b comparisons, forcing a contiguous set of valid positions. Intersections of insertion-position image sets are q^(b-d) for d<=b and a period indicator for d>b. Consecutive interval tail counts invert by second differences. Uniform random comparison indicators along b disjoint paths are independent Bernoulli(1/q). Boundary s=m+1 is handled separately. The standalone checker covers 736 source centers, 54,360 outputs and additional exact-rational random-law cases.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The total sphere size and equivalence criterion are explicitly treated as prior. The full N_s(y) histogram entails intersecting each pair of position-image sets, counting consecutive histories, taking second differences, and using the forest independence of random centers. These additional steps are not implied as stated numerical conclusions by known ball-size formulas. The period-b lemma makes the approach possible, so an unindexed implicit derivation is a real risk.

value.rationale: The exact nonuniform output probability mass spectrum under a natural uniform insertion mechanism is a motivated alignment-ambiguity invariant, more informative than known ball cardinalities. A closed center-dependent spectrum for all parameters, rigid low multiplicity counts, mean distribution and exact longest-run extreme-value reduction are mathematically natural complete classifications with applications to induced output concentration.
